title: KitchenAid Gourmet 4-Sided Stainless Steel Box Grater for Fine, Medium and Coarse Grate, and Slicing, Detachable 3 Cup Storage Container and Measurment Markings, Dishwasher Safe, 10 inches tall, Black
description:
About this item
High quality stainless steel: This box grater is constructed from high quality, rust resistant stainless steel. It allows for easy, mess-free grating of cheeses, vegetables and more. It also features a stainless steel top handle for superior comfort
4 different grating patterns: The grater features 3 grating surfaces and 1 slicing blade. Fine blade, Medium, Coarse blade, Slicing blade.
Includes storage container: a 3-cup container fits inside the box grater to catch the grated or sliced food, allowing for easy storage
Capacity markings on container: The container has capacity markings of 1/2-cup, 1-cup, 1 1/2-cup, and 2-cup, allowing for precise grating measurements for any recipe
Dishwasher safe: Dishwasher safe for fast and easy cleanup; 1-year Hassle-Free replacement and lifetime limited

reviews_5s:
Hadn’t used one before. Kinda fun. Carrots grated for carrot cake at Easter. Tried potatoes on single blade on the other side for a casserole which sliced thin enough to make potato chips. Made my own hash brown potatoes to vac/seal in freezer for another day. Lost the skin on a thumb knuckle OUCH! After that used a little utensil to hold the smaller pieces to complete the shredding. Love the handleWorks well and high quality! Great value and I love the little container that fits inside. It grates easily and is sharp so far!Durable, high quality construction, heavy (in a good way), thick metalWife loves it. Big improvement over smaller shredder…..much faster for high volume. Yes, it’s bigger than options, but that investment in storage space pays off!The different size graters on different sides are excellent, and the container that snaps onto the bottom to catch grated food is perfect for not only catching but also storing.Not your grandma's grater! Covered handle makes it comfortable to use and it's lovely and sharp. The handy cup on the bottom is very convenient and has a lid. Best I've owned! Saves me hauling out (and cleaning!) my food processor for smaller quantities.We needed a cheese grater. This one works well. Great for soft and hard cheese. A little bulky, but the 4 different graters are needed. I like the container which catches the shredded cheese.This grater feels solid in hand and handles everything from cheese to carrots with ease. Each side grates or slices cleanly without slipping around, and the handle has a good grip. The best part is the container that fits snugly at the bottom—it catches everything neatly, so there’s less mess and no need to chase shreds around the counter and is so easy to pack as it fits inside the grater without taking extra space. Simple tool, but really well thought out.I want to preface this with my belief that you don't buy a new item if your current item can still be used and KitchenAid products generally last. I purchased the combo package of a grater with storage/measuring cup and a Manual Can Opener. First, the Grater: I may have purchased the grater this was to replace in the early to mid 1980's. Certainly no later than 1990! This grater, with the hard plastic collar and top handle seems like it will never collapse in on itself, as my old one finally did. It's slightly larger overall and, while space is always tight in a well used kitchen, it stores its own measuring cup/covered container, so I'll forgive it. The container, with it's own seal, is very handy as I no longer have to grate onto a paper towel and then transfer that to a measuring cup. I could say that it stops one from wasting cheese when you grate too much but the "extra" was always consumed by kids, dogs & hubby wandering by and pinching a bit here & there... well, not the dogs, everyone generously shared their snagged bits with them, woof woof 😜 😉
The Manual Can Opener: I am blown away by the ease of use and quality of this product. I have an opener that never caught the can edge properly, needed excessive pressure to hold the handles tightly together and usually needed repeated repositioning every time I needed to open a can! As my arthritis has worsened, I often needed someone else to help and watched THEM have the same issues. Anyway, when my grater collapsed, I saw the package with both and ordered it immediately. This opener is extremely easy to use, it doesn't open very wide but, I placed it on a can, gave a little squeeze and easily turned the handle just a couple of times before the lid dropped into the mandarin oranges! I was flabbergasted at the ease of use because I've been using the old one for several years, often got pinched and would just give up on trying to get a lid entirely off. We would pry the can open with something else until we could scoop out the contents. Luckily, we don't really open many cans and, until the mandarin oranges stopped having "pull tops" it was rare to NEED an opener. I'm not cheap, I AM frugal. I don't know where the old opener came from but, I know KitchenAid. For well over 35 years, I've owned a (refurbished) KitchenAid Mixer including many of the attachments and several other KitchenAid products. Every item with their name on it has provided years of service and they stand behind their products. This package was more expensive than most of the others and that's a consideration for some but I'm confident that I'll save money in the long run. Spend a couple of extra dollars now and you won't have to replace the items as often.This grater is a MUST HAVE for every kitchen!!! The pullout storage container with lid makes this an extra special item! Great quality, cleans easily! I love it!!!
reviews_1s:
This is not sharp at all and one really has to put some good old elbow grease into grating whatever you want.
My almost 40 year old one does a better job, way easier to use, whether grating soft or hard items such as carrots.
A shame they don't make things like they used to. My old one has long lost its plastic handle, which makes it a little more difficult to hold whilst using, but it's out with the new and in with the old for me.This fancy grater does not even grate a carrot without pressing on it very firmly. I am very disappointed with this product and would not recommend it to anyone else. It is not sharp enough to do basic grating. I have a simple grater that I have had for years that does better but it needed to be replaced because it was getting dull.The blades (serrations) on this grater are very dull and the product couldn’t even begin to shred a head of cabbage. We were fooled into believing the KitchenAid name meant quality. 👎👎Unfortunately, I didn’t like it at all!! It is so bulky and hard to use. I need to put on a lot of pressure to shred a carrot. I have cut myself twice already. Wish I could return it but I started using it only a month after a purchase.I thought any box grater will work fine, so I purchased with this name brand item. It looks and feels fine until I start using it. The cutting part of grater is so dull that it did not sharply cut and grate anything. The cutting edge smashed and crushed the food, not cutting it. Accordingly, the food stuck to the cutting edge and block the hole. It is the grater's nightmare.
Do not buy this, you will end up buying another one anyway.The grater was not sharp and ended up shredding (not in a good way) my carrots instead of grating them. The size is rather large and clunky but also felt cheap. Quite let down by the quality for Kitchen Aid name brand.Between the top and bottom casing, there isn't much rim to actually grate cheese and it's really awkward. I would not buy this again.I wanted to slice my potatoes with it it wouldn't cut them I could cut them faster with a butter knife I hate it!This looks like a good concept but just does not work. Half the grated pieces fall outside the box and make a big mess. It is just too huge for an everyday utensil.
I bought a 3-4 inch box grater years ago but now it seems they just don’t make them any moreThis cheese grater was used and taped back together. GROSS. Returning.
